title: Edge-of-Chaos
description: Falsifiable research programme and digital-twin metrology platform (Python + Rust) testing the necessary physical conditions for primary interoceptive sentience in continuous neuromorphic substrates.
notes: v0.3.0 implements the three operational demarcation conditions of the programme (causal non-separability, non-Markovian memory, state-dependent effective dynamics), which were missing, and rewrites the criteria for three necessary conditions (edge of chaos, causal degeneracy, exponent stability) to follow their definitions in the papers: the earlier functions computed different quantities. It also adds input validation, known-answer tests, continuous integration and a demonstration notebook, and makes the PyO3 module call the Rust engine. See CHANGELOG.md for details and known open issues.
